paper_container: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
question: On FOREAGENT's exact common released pair grid, can a label-free task-local graph projection improve fixed DeepSeek or GPT pairwise judgments when the target edge is excluded from its own reconstruction?

not_computed_or_read_before_freeze: hybrid-minus-raw point estimates, confidence intervals or LOTO signs

support.population: The same 18,381-pair, 26-task exact common finite directional support already frozen for FOREAGENT UST sensitivity.
support.deepseek_grid: The three released grids must be exactly equal within task.
support.gpt_grid: Use the three-release intersection within task before cross-model intersection.
support.truth: Finite non-tied score-derived winner, direction and score mapping must agree across all six model-release records.
support.triplicate_flow: Encode each released winner as +1 or -1 under a canonical endpoint orientation and average the three signs. Missing predictions encode zero; any zero triplicate majority fails closed for this fixed released support.
support.graph: One task-local graph on common support; every task must be connected and total incidence rank must equal 868.

method.name: leave-one-edge-out Hodge least-squares baseline
method.fit: For each fixed model and task, fit node potentials to the mean signed triplicate edge flow by unweighted ordinary least squares.
method.target_edge_exclusion: For edge e, compute the prediction fitted without e using (fitted_e - h_e*y_e)/(1-h_e), where h_e is its incidence leverage. Synthetic tests must match brute-force edge deletion.
method.truth_access: The graph fit and target-edge prediction use model judgments and topology only. Truth is accessed only to score the already-produced sign.
method.bridge_or_zero_policy: If h_e is within 1e-10 of one or the leave-one-out prediction has absolute value at most 1e-12, LOEO abstains. The practical full-coverage hybrid falls back to the raw triplicate majority on that edge.
method.primary: Equal-task task-macro hybrid-minus-raw accuracy for each fixed model.
secondary: LOEO-only minus raw on the identical LOEO-evaluable support

inference.bootstrap: Resample the 26 tasks with replacement and recompute equal-task and ratio estimands.
inference.confidence_interval: Empirical 2.5 and 97.5 percent order statistics with fixed indices.

frozen_classification_gates.supporting_graph_consistency_baseline_im: Coverage passes, at least one fixed model has a task-macro hybrid-minus-raw 95% CI strictly above zero, and both model point changes are nonnegative.
frozen_classification_gates.no_denoising_gain_model_comparison_remai: The improvement gate fails but the hybrid DeepSeek-minus-GPT task-macro 95% CI remains strictly above zero.

independent_implementations.producer: Canonical-left-minus-right incidence, Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse and analytic OLS leave-one-out.
independent_implementations.verifier: Opposite orientation, grounded reduced-Laplacian inverse and independent parser/aggregation.
synthetic_controls: closed-form LOEO equals brute-force deletion on every K4 edge
tree edges have leverage one and abstain
orientation reversal preserves the physical prediction
reversed source pair order canonicalizes identically

related_work_boundary.scoop_gate: The method family is not novel. Classical Hodge/least-squares ranking, Bradley-Terry aggregation, non-transitivity diagnostics, TrustJudge, Sage and 2026 Topological Consensus Rewards already establish graph/global-consistency aggregation or denoising.
related_work_boundary.allowed_claim: A leak-free graph-consistency baseline and domain transfer result for the MLE-solution predictor benchmark.
forbidden_claims: first use of transitivity or cycles for LLM judges
replacement of the frozen critic estimand
effective sample size or independent-label count

integrity.failure_policy: Any source hash, schema, support, graph, arithmetic, trace, identity, test, verifier, security or byte mismatch stops without scientific interpretation.
